events.why: from the nurse to the Center's wall west (0, 4) and up to the wall (0, 2), as 12.01 does: legs to walls, so the walk out starts from a known tile even if the Center script left the player a tile off the nurse
out of the Center's door onto Fuchsia City, where Fly works

the Pidgey (Fly, 10.01), found in the party by its summary's species, flies to Celadon City (pokeguy flies there after Koga, 1:23:45), landing below the Pokemon Center's door (48, 11) on its heal spot, where 14.03 starts

checkpoint: From Fuchsia's nurse, where 12.02 ends healed, to Celadon for Erika (14.03): out of the Center on foot (Fly works outdoors only) and Fly. Celadon's landing, its heal spot (48, 12) facing south, is where 14.03 starts, so no walk follows.
Fuchsia and Celadon are both Fly towns the Pidgey already knows (11.01, 11.03); no new step or measurement.
